title: Janson's joint distribution conjecture for DFS arc counts
statement:
Consider a random multidigraph on $n$ vertices with geometric outdegree distribution: independently for each vertex $v$, let $d^+(v)$ be geometrically distributed with mode $0$ and mean $\frac{p}{1-p}$, for $p\in(0,1)$, and choose the heads of its arcs independently and uniformly from the vertices. In a depth-first search, let $L,F,B,C,T$ denote the numbers of loops, forward, back, cross, and tree arcs, respectively. **Janson's conjecture.** The random vectors

$$
(L,F,B+C,T)\quad\text{and}\quad(L,B,F+C,T)
$$

have the same distribution.

This extends Knuth's conjecture by asserting a joint distributional symmetry among all five DFS arc types. The source presents it as a proposed extension; no resolution is supplied here.
source_name: Zipei Nie, “On a conjecture of Knuth about forward and back arcs”, arXiv:2301.05704 (2023).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2301.05704

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of January 2023).
